sets.title: Quick Quiz
sets.description: Test your knowledge of days, months, and their case forms
sets.descriptionRussian: Проверьте знание дней недели, месяцев и их падежных форм

items.prompt: Урок в _____. (The lesson is on Friday.)
items.explanation: Days of the week use в + accusative: пятница -> в пятницу.

items.prompt: Каникулы начинаются в _____. (Vacation starts in August.)
items.explanation: Months use в + prepositional: август -> в августе.

items.hint: Wednesday is the third day of the week in Russia.
items.explanation: The order is: понедельник, вторник, среда, четверг. Thursday follows Wednesday.

items.prompt: Цветы появляются в _____. (Flowers appear in May.)
items.explanation: 'In May' = в мае (prepositional case of май).

minimalPairs.explanation: 'On [day]' = в + accusative. Вторник is masculine and stays unchanged in the accusative.

sets.title: Fill and Sort
sets.description: Fill in the correct forms and sort days from months
sets.descriptionRussian: Вставьте правильные формы и рассортируйте дни и месяцы

blanks: Занятия начинаются в _____. (Classes start on Monday.)
Праздник в _____. (The holiday is in November.)
Мы гуляем в парке в _____. (We walk in the park on Sunday.)
Школа открывается в _____. (School opens in September.)
fillInBlank.grammarFocus: Days use в + accusative (no ending change for masculine), months use в + prepositional (-е ending).
hints: Masculine day, accusative stays the same.
Neuter day, accusative stays the same.
explanations: В понедельник: masculine inanimate nouns don't change in the accusative.
В ноябре: ноябрь -> ноябре in the prepositional case.
В воскресенье: neuter nouns don't change in the accusative.
В сентябре: сентябрь -> сентябре in the prepositional case.

categorySorting.instruction: Sort: Day of the Week or Month?

translation.hint: I = я, work = работаю, Wednesday accusative = среду
birthday = день рождения, October prepositional = октябре
we = мы, rest = отдыхаем, Saturday accusative = субботу

sets.title: Spot the Errors
sets.description: Find and fix case errors in sentences about days and months
sets.descriptionRussian: Найдите и исправьте падежные ошибки в предложениях о днях и месяцах

errorCorrection.explanation: Среда is feminine, so it changes in the accusative: среда -> среду. В среду.
Months use в + prepositional: март -> в марте.

errorCorrection.hint: Feminine days change in the accusative.
errorCorrection.explanation: Суббота is feminine: суббота -> субботу in the accusative. В субботу.

errorCorrection.hint: Months need the prepositional case after в.
errorCorrection.explanation: 'In October' = в октябре. The prepositional ending is -е.

items.prompt: Which form is correct: 'в пятница' or 'в пятницу'?
items.promptEnglish: Which is the correct form for 'on Friday'?
items.explanation: Пятница is feminine: пятница -> пятницу in the accusative. В пятницу.
'In June' = в июне. Prepositional case: июнь -> июне.

items.prompt: What is the last month of the year?
items.promptEnglish: What is the last month of the year?
items.explanation: Декабрь (December) is the 12th and last month of the year.

sets.title: Mixed Challenge
sets.description: A mixed challenge covering days, months, and case forms
sets.descriptionRussian: Смешанное задание по дням недели, месяцам и падежным формам

patternRecognition.sentence: в понедельник, в четверг, во вторник
patternRecognition.question: What case do these day-of-the-week forms use after в?
patternRecognition.explanation: 'On [day]' uses в + accusative. Masculine days like понедельник, четверг, вторник stay unchanged in the accusative.

patternRecognition.sentence: в январе, в марте, в июне
patternRecognition.question: What case do these month forms use after в?
patternRecognition.explanation: 'In [month]' uses в + prepositional. The -е ending is the prepositional marker.

patternRecognition.sentence: в среду, в субботу, в пятницу
patternRecognition.question: Why do these days end in -у after в?
options: They are feminine nouns in the accusative case
They are in the prepositional case
They are in the genitive case
patternRecognition.answer: They are feminine nouns in the accusative case
patternRecognition.explanation: Среда, суббота, пятница are feminine. Feminine -а nouns change to -у in the accusative: в среду, в субботу, в пятницу.

minimalPairs.explanation: 'On [day]' = в + accusative. Четверг is masculine and stays unchanged.
'On [day]' = в + accusative. Среда is feminine: среда -> среду.

blanks: У нас собрание в _____. (We have a meeting on Monday.)
Новый семестр в _____. (The new semester is in February.)
fillInBlank.grammarFocus: Months use prepositional (в мае, в феврале), days use accusative (в понедельник).
hints: Masculine day, accusative stays the same.
explanations: В мае: май -> мае in the prepositional case.
В понедельник: masculine inanimate nouns don't change in the accusative.
В феврале: февраль -> феврале in the prepositional case.
